hero.subtitle: A template library built for sellers, KOCs, and KOLs — turn one product video into multiple high-impact clips, ready to publish in minutes.

featuresSection.label: Key capabilities
featuresSection.title: Everything you need to ship sales video faster
featuresSection.subtitle: From ready-made templates to cutting, captions, and export — designed for short-form commerce content.

features.title: One source video — many publish-ready versions
features.description: Reuse existing product footage to create multiple versions with different openings, highlights, and lengths. Keep posting consistently without reshooting.

features.title: Sales-focused template library
features.description: Templates purpose-built for sellers, KOCs, and KOLs: unboxing, product review, before/after, feature demo, and purchase CTA. Select a template, add your footage, export in platform-ready ratios.

features.title: Captions and dialogue built for conversion
features.description: Remove filler, sharpen the sales message, and add captions that emphasize price, offers, and product benefits — so viewers understand quickly in the vertical feed.
bullets: Captions that highlight pricing, promotions, and key selling points.
Clearer dialogue for product reviews and livestream cutdowns.

features.title: Content variants that stay distinct
features.description: Adjust pacing, framing, and effects so each version from the same source still feels unique — ideal when managing multiple SKUs or distribution channels.

installSection.label: Installation
installSection.title: Installation guide
macSteps: Drag the application into the Applications folder.
Open Terminal (press ⌘ Space, then type Terminal).
winSteps: Download the installer from the options above.
Open the file to complete installation and launch the app.
If Windows Defender shows a warning, select More info, then Run anyway.
iosSteps: Open the App Store link in the Mobile section (when available).
Tap Install and sign in with your Apple ID if prompted.
Open Tizan Cut Pro from your Home Screen.
androidSteps: Open the Google Play link in the Mobile section (when available).
Tap Install and accept permissions if prompted.
Open Tizan Cut Pro from your app list.
